issue.title: Fix React channel env missing in custom server
issue.body:
Fixes #48948 ([repro](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/48948#issuecomment-1533542001)). When running inside a custom server with app dir, we should always opt into the prebundled React with correct channels.

Thanks @karlhorky for help testing it!

Fixes #49169 too.
